card.name: Possessive 's after eponymous disease names
card.fires_on: The apostrophe-s ending right after a person's surname in a disease or syndrome name, such as Reye, Paget, Cushing, Kaposi or Tyzzer. It also fires on Hartmann's Solution.

modes.label: Eponymous diseases
modes.description: The 's follows a doctor's surname that names a disease or syndrome.
modes.example: WARNINGS Reye<<’s>> Syndrome may develop in individuals who have chicken

modes.label: Eponymous solution
modes.description: The 's follows a surname in the name of a fluid.
modes.example: Compound Sodium Lactate Solution, and Hartmann<<'s>> Solution.

card.writes: It promotes honorific words for a person (Mr., Dr., teacher), and suppresses hyphenated letter endings, so it pushes toward a person-title reading of the name.
card.plain: It marks the 's on a scientist's name when that name is used for a disease, like Paget's or Reye's.
